title: langgraph-cli==0.4.35
summary: Changes since cli==0.4.34 release(cli): 0.4.35 ( #9310 ) feat(cli): add --image-pull-secret for deploying through a private registry ( #9305 ) feat(cli): log in with the registry username the control plane returns ( #9301 ) fix(cli): preserve failed deployment build logs ( #9308 ) chore(deps): bump handlebars from 4.7.9 to 4.7.10 in /libs/cli/js-examples ( #9286 )
body:
Changes since cli==0.4.34

- release(cli): 0.4.35 ( #9310 )

- feat(cli): add --image-pull-secret for deploying through a private registry ( #9305 )

- feat(cli): log in with the registry username the control plane returns ( #9301 )

- fix(cli): preserve failed deployment build logs ( #9308 )

- chore(deps): bump handlebars from 4.7.9 to 4.7.10 in /libs/cli/js-examples ( #9286 )
summaryZh: LangGraph CLI发布了0.4.35版本更新。此次迭代主要新增了通过私有镜像仓库部署时的--image-pull-secret支持、控制平面注册表用户名登录功能，并修复了部署构建失败时日志被清除的问题。

aiReview.reasonZh: LangGraph CLI发布新版本，带来了针对私有镜像仓库部署和错误日志保留的关键改进。
